`enum ShaderFillType`<br/>
**Package:** `dev.joid.lib.shader.impl` · **Module:** `core` · **Source:** [ShaderFillType.java](https://github.com/Zeldown/JOID/blob/main/core/src/main/java/dev/joid/lib/shader/impl/ShaderFillType.java)

What the rounded and circle shaders mask: the texture tinted by the color, the texture alone, or the color alone.

## Learn more

- [Shaders](/use/learn/going-further/shaders/)

## Values

| Value | Summary |
|---|---|
| [`AUTO`](#ShaderFillType-value-AUTO) | Masks the bound texture multiplied by the vertex color, the case of shapes and images. |
| [`TEXTURE`](#ShaderFillType-value-TEXTURE) | Masks the bound texture alone, premultiplied, the case of a shader pass on a framebuffer. |
| [`COLOR`](#ShaderFillType-value-COLOR) | Masks the vertex color alone and ignores the texture. |

## Value details

<a id="ShaderFillType-value-AUTO"></a>

### AUTO

<a id="ShaderFillType-value-TEXTURE"></a>

### TEXTURE

`TEXTURE` 

Masks the bound texture alone, premultiplied, the case of a shader pass on a framebuffer.

<a id="ShaderFillType-value-COLOR"></a>

### COLOR

`COLOR` 

Masks the vertex color alone and ignores the texture.
